description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 10.11.2025 to 16.11.2025
reasoning: The gazette content is a "Customs Notification (General)" issued under the Customs Ordinance. It formally announces new statutory rates of exchange for calculating customs duties and other charges, and rescinds a previous notification. This falls squarely under the definition of a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5), as it pertains to regulatory frameworks, statutory instruments, and compliance requirements under a specific ordinance. It does not involve government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3) or fit any other specialized category like Land, Commercial, etc.
